capabilities: Sync vault files across devices via a Git repository
Merge concurrent text edits using CRDTs
Browse sync history and compare local, remote, and merged files
Download files on demand to save local storage
Consolidate old history or repair damaged metadata
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile support is experimental and untested on physical devices. On-demand downloads mean file contents must be fetched before search, backlinks, or other plugins can read them. Symbolic links and junctions in the vault are unsafe and warned against. More detail lives in separate FEATURES.md and CONTRIBUTING.md files.
problem: Obsidian Sync costs money and plain Git syncs do not merge concurrent edits, so users need a way to sync offline changes without manual conflict resolution.

requires.name: Git host with a repository and credentials

summary: Syncs a vault across devices using a Git repository, merging concurrent text edits automatically with CRDTs so offline work converges.
